name: MATRIX_POWER_SUM_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaces a simple inequality (x != y) with the determinant of a 3x3 Gram matrix of power sums, incorporating node indices to feign edge-dependence. This mathematically evaluates to a scaled square of the difference, preserving the exact truth values while preventing the model from recognizing the problem as standard graph coloring and applying degree-ordered optimizations.
